description:
Effective property tax rate for a 5-digit ZIP code (Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area, ACS 5-year medians), with
        the US rate. Pass `home_value` for a rough estimate of the yearly tax at that rate (an illustration, not a bill).
        `small_sample` flags ZIP codes with under 200 owner-occupied homes (wide margin of error).
name: property_tax_rate_by_zip
